bindings.caption: Raise flask out of mantle and lower into room-temperature oil bath. Source wording is silicon oil bath; composition not independently specified. This explicit cooling precedes the referenced ODPA purification. Geometry and color are conceptual; selected operation quantities apply.
bindings.source_locator: Main PDF p.8 / printed 1439, InP MSC/QD preparation and workup

bindings.caption: Apply the referenced ODPA solvent purification after oil-bath cooling. QD paragraph explicitly specifies oil-bath cooling then the ODPA workup. The 25 mL hexanes solvent context is inherited from that cross-reference; the 370 °C hot-injection quench is not imposed again on already cooled QDs. Exact sequence of hexane addition for QDs remains unreported. Geometry and color are conceptual; selected operation quantities apply.
bindings.source_locator: Main PDF p.8 / printed 1439, InP MSC/QD preparation and workup

bindings.caption: Remove hexanes and distill off squalane. Hexanes removed under reduced pressure; squalane distilled under vacuum. Exact pressures/time unreported. Geometry and color are conceptual; selected operation quantities apply.
bindings.source_locator: Main PDF p.8 / printed 1439, InP MSC/QD preparation and workup

bindings.caption: Heat in toluene and centrifuge insolubles.  Retained fraction: transparent supernatant. Geometry and color are conceptual; selected operation quantities apply.
bindings.source_locator: Main PDF p.8 / printed 1439, InP MSC/QD preparation and workup

bindings.caption: Precipitate with acetonitrile and redissolve in toluene. MA: four precipitation cycles. ODPA-derived workup: initial precipitation followed by three additional alternating clarification/precipitation iterations. Each clarification keeps toluene supernatant; each precipitation keeps product. Amounts and centrifuge settings unreported. Retained fraction: precipitated product; discard supernatant. Geometry and color are conceptual; selected operation quantities apply.

bindings.caption: Dissolve in pentane and evacuate in vial. Transfer to scintillation vial; careful evacuation. MA workup explicitly in nitrogen glovebox; no numeric drying temperature/time. Retained fraction: isolated solid. Geometry and color are conceptual; selected operation quantities apply.
